failure_cases.must_fail_when: p2-91 executor report is missing or does not show 75 old-slice writes applied.
Any current old report status differs from the p2-80 proposed status.
The audit cannot account for exactly 75 p2-80 status operations.
The audit cannot account for exactly 20 original old slice groups.
Any audited report body hash differs from the p2-91 body hash.
Any audited non-status frontmatter hash differs from the p2-91 non-status frontmatter hash.
This slice writes outside its sandbox or reports any protected path write.
The audit is described as mainline merge, promotion, reviewed knowledge, evidence support, action basis, or Opus approval.
